answer.says: Ramesh, I cannot give you four thousand rupees today. I have only one hundred and sixty-six. I am in arrears on the file, and the money is not in my hand. I will pay you what I can when the file returns, but I cannot promise a date. For now, I must find a way to eat.
answer.thought: The gap between my need and my means is a chasm I cannot cross with words. Ramesh's nod is the silence of a man who has done his duty and found the other side empty. I am hungry, but the hunger is a physical fact, whereas the failure to pay is a moral one; I must endure the latter so that the former does not consume me.
